generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: A system can validate a legitimate evidence, review or approval object and validate an independently legitimate effect while failing to prove that the specific effect is inside the scope authorized by that source.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Check evidence existence and generic effect eligibility indepently, then execute the requested mutation without comparing the effect identity to the source scope.
trigger_signals: evidence or review defines affected operations
emergency or override reaches the same effect through a different branch
persisted authorization scope is consumed later
generalized_learning.reusable_control: Use deliberately divergent source and effect identities; admit the matching effect, reject an unrelated effect and a mixed request before mutation, and repeat under exception and commit-time branches.
generalized_learning.prevention_rule: Derive the authorized effect set from the canonical source at the definitive effect boundary; exception branches may change timing or preconditions but may not silently widen scope.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: Require AUTH-EFFECT-SCOPE-001 style divergent fixtures plus commit-time revalidation when the scope is persisted or mutable.

transfer_cases.procedure: Synthetic approval authorizes resource_a while request targets resource_b; assert fail-closed before mutation.
Synthetic emergency evidence authorizes operation_a while override requests operation_b and a mixed operation_a+operation_b request; assert atomic rejection.

skill_changes.description: Require source/effect divergence and commit-bound scope derivation.
Require authorization:evidence-effect-scope and exception-branch sibling coverage.
